SELECT 
    rc.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    risk_classification rc
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY 
    rc.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF';

SELECT 
    payment_id,
    business_date,
    amount
FROM 
    payment_event
WHERE 
    payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
    AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY 
    amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY 
    pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT 
    pc.card_id,
    pc.issued_on,
    pc.expires_on
FROM 
    payment_card pc
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
ORDER BY 
    pc.issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou_target ON op.registered_region = ou_target.region_code
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou_shanghai ON ou_target.region_code = ou_shanghai.region_code
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND ou_shanghai.unit_name = '上海分行'
ORDER BY 
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, 
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_market_value
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(abs.balance_snapshot), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND abs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM account_balance_snapshot abs2 
        WHERE abs2.account_id = a.account_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_principal_overdue_days
FROM 
    delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY 
    avg_principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND eg.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 6) AS npl_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM risk_classification rc2 
        WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_code, i.sector_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 1!5;

SELECT 
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM 
    wealth_product
GROUP BY 
    risk_level
ORDER BY 
    risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_balance
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) > 300000000
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(dse.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM 
    data_security_event_v3 dse
JOIN 
    institution i ON dse.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    dse.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN 
    institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
    AND r.deadline_date < '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    overdue_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan!id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
    AND rc.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date) 
        FROM risk_classification rc2 
        WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date =!rc.as_of_date
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) > 100000000
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    op.display_name,
    ind.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party op ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile orgp ON op.party_id = orgp.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind ON orgp.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS non_compliant_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_instruction_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.!0 / SUM(pi.in!0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.maturity_on IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY 
    ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS loan_agreement_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p!display_name
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name,
    ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    op_ind.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    ca_ind.sector_name_zh AS agreement_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector op_ind ON op.industry_code = op_ind.sector_code
JOIN 
    industry_sector ca_ind ON ca.target_industry_code = ca_ind.sector_code
WHERE 
    op.industry_code IS NOT NULL 
    AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL 
    AND op.industry_code != ca.target_industry_code
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount,
    p_from.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    p_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON acc_from.account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON acc_to.account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party_relation pr ON ah_from.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND ah_to.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN party p_from ON ah_from.party_id = p_from.party_id
JOIN party p_to ON ah_to.party_id = p_to.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a_from ON pe.from_account_id = a_from.account_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON a_from.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000.0
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN 
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON to_acc.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isc ON op.industry_code = isc.sector_code
WHERE 
    isc.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY 
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    cdd.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cdd.event_date,
    cdd.deadline_date,
    ROUND(JULIANDAY('2026-06-30') - JULIANDAY(cdd.deadline_date), 0) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN 
    institution i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cdd.completion_date IS NULL
    AND cdd.event_date <= '2026-0!6-30'
ORDER BY 
    days_overdue DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS agreement_status
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
   !sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    so.covered_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    so.covered_amount DESC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, ld.disbursed_amount) AS principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, ld.disbursed_amount) DESC, ld.!loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id 
        AND lbs.as_of_date = (
            SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
            FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
            WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
        )
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_name,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        rn,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY institution_name 
            ORDER BY principal_balance DESC
        ) AS balance_rank
    FROM loan_balances
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    balance_rank
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        op.industry_code,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY op.industry_code
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    ind.sector_name_zh,
    lr.loan_id,
    ROUND(lr.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    lr.rn
FROM loan_ranked lr
JOIN industry_sector ind ON lr.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE lr.rn <= 3
ORDER BY ind.sector_name_zh ASC, lr.rn ASC;

SELECT
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM (
    SELECT
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
) t
ORDER BY business_date;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ROUND(inst_avg.avg_balance, 2) AS institution_avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - inst_avg.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ca_inner.institution_id,
            AVG(lbs_inner.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
        FROM 
            loan_balance_snapshot lbs_inner
        JOIN 
            loan_drawdown ld_inner ON lbs_inner.loan_id = ld_inner.loan_id
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement ca_inner ON ld_inner.agreement_id = ca_inner.agreement_id
        WHERE 
            lbs_inner.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        GROUP BY 
            ca_inner.institution_id
    ) inst_avg ON ca.institution_id = inst_avg.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.principal_balance > inst_avg.avg_balance
ORDER BY 
    excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END AS interval_lower_bound,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
WHERE d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END
ORDER BY interval_lower_bound ASC;

SELECT

    -- Re-writing with correct joins:

    -- credit_agreement ca JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id

SELECT

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 6) AS high_income_ratio
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY

WITH transaction_base AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        pe.amount,
        ah_from.party_id AS from_party_id,
        ah_to.party_id AS!to_party_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
    JOIN account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
    JOIN institution i ON COALESCE(acc_from.institution_id, acc_to.institution_id) = i.institution_id
    JOIN account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    JOIN account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    WHERE pe.business_date <= '2026-06-30'
),
related_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        tb.institution_id,
        tb.institution_name,
        tb.amount
    FROM transaction_base tb
    JOIN party_relation pr 
        ON tb.from_party_id = pr.source_party_id 
        AND tb.to_party_id = pr.target_party_id
        AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
        AND pr.effective_from <= '2026-06-30'
        AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')
)
SELECT 
    rt.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(rt.amount), 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(tb.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(rt.amount) * 1.0 / SUM(tb.amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM related_transactions rt
JOIN transaction_base tb ON rt.institution_id = tb.institution_id
GROUP BY rt.institution_id, rt.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.card_type = 'CREDIT' THEN pc.card_id END) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON ah.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    term_deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY('2026-06-30') - JULIANDAY(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld

    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    avg_loan_age_days DESC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balances
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        SUM(l.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot l
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON l.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
    WHERE l.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY i.sector_name_zh
),
total_balance AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_balance) AS grand_total FROM industry_loan_balance
),
industry_with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        ilb.industry_name,
        ilb.total_balance,
        SUM(ilb.total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY ilb.total_balance DESC) AS cumulative_balance
    FROM industry_loan_balance ilb
)
SELECT 
    iwc.industry_name,
    ROUND(iwc.total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(iwc.cumulative_balance * 1.0 / tb.grand_total, 6) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM industry_with_cumulative iwc
CROSS JOIN total_balance tb
WHERE (iwc.cumulative_balance * 1.0 / tb.grand_total) <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    ROUND(cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS latest_valuation
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cv.valuation_amount > (sa.secured_amount * 2.0)
    AND cv.valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
        FROM collateral_valuation cv2
        WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

GROUP BY

HAVING

SELECT

GROUP BY

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

    AND lpc.product_family = 'WORKING_CAPITAL'

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        i.institution_name
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
institution_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        AVG(principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_balances
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT 
    lb.institution_name,
    lb.loan_id,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(ia.avg_balance, 2) AS institution_avg_balance,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_difference
FROM loan_balances lb
JOIN institution_averages ia ON lb.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance > 2 * ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_difference DESC;

WITH all_exposures AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.in!institution_id = ca.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
),
non_related_exposures AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
          AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    )
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    ae.institution_name AS "机构名称",
    COALESCE(nre.non_related_amount, 0.0) AS "非关联金额",
    ae.total_amount AS "全部金额",
    ROUND(COALESCE(nre.non_related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / ae.total_amount, 6) AS "占比"
FROM all_exposures ae
LEFT JOIN non_related_exposures nre ON ae.institution_id = nre.institution_id
ORDER BY "占比" DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND op.party_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) > 0.10
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.target_industry_code,
        ROUND(AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate), 6) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS execution_rate,
    ROUND(iar.avg_rate, 4) AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - iar.avg_rate) * 100.0 / iar.avg_rate, 2) AS markup_percent
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_avg_rates iar ON ca.target_industry_code = iar.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND iar.avg_rate > 0
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - iar.avg_rate) / iar.avg_rate > 0.10
ORDER BY markup_percent DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) AS excess_customer_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.in!institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON ld.loan_account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND lbs.principal_balance > (cs.net_capital * 0.10)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    excess_customer_count DESC;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
capital_data AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    ge.exposure_group_id AS group_id,
    ge.group_name,
    ROUND(ge.total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cd.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(ge.total_balance * 1.0 / cd.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM group_exposure ge
JOIN capital_data cd ON ge.institution_id = cd.institution_id
WHERE (ge.total_balance * 1.0 / cd.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'MATURED'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_interval
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON ld.disbursement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE 
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
    AND CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - juli!julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) <= 7
    AND CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) >= 0
ORDER BY 
    days_interval ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
capital_net AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND currency_code = 'CNY'
),
customer_ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.borrower_party_id,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        lb.total_loan_balance,
        cn.net_capital,
        ROUND(lb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / cn.net_capital, 6) AS ratio_value
    FROM loan_balances lb
    JOIN capital_net cn ON lb.institution_id = cn.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON lb.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE cn.net_capital > 0
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        customer_name,
        ratio_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY ratio_value DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_ratios
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    rc.customer_name,
    rc.ratio_value
FROM ranked_customers rc
JOIN institution i ON rc.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rc.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_rank
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ca.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC
        ) AS quartile_rank
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
) ranked_loans
WHERE quartile_rank IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
ORDER BY quartile_rank ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(
        lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / SUM(lbs.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id) * 100.0, 
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    i.institution_name ASC,
    (lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / SUM(lbs.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id)) DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id AND rs.due_date = (
        SELECT MAX(due_date) FROM repayment_schedule WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id AND installment_no <= rs.installment_no
    )
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
    AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING 
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    overdue_installment_count DESC,
    total_overdue_principal DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id

JOIN staff_member s ON p.party_id = s.person_party_id

WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'

FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
    SELECT pe.from_account_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type

      AND pe.from_account_id IS NOT NULL
  )

LIMIT 300;

    gc.security_id,
    gc.guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'EXPIRED'

WITH maturity_buckets AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN '已到期'
            WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN '临期'
            ELSE '常态'
        END AS bucket_name,
        CASE
            WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN 3
            WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS sort_order
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
)
SELECT
    bucket_name AS "档位",
    COUNT(*) AS "笔数"
FROM maturity_buckets
GROUP BY bucket_name, sort_order
ORDER BY sort_order ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS link_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) > 1
ORDER BY 
    link_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cv.appraiser_kind = 'BANK_INTERNAL'

ORDER BY

WITH account_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id) AS total_loan_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
filtered_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        repayment_account_id,
        loan_id,
        disbursed_on,
        disbursed_amount,
        total_loan_count
    FROM account_loan_stats
    WHERE total_loan_count >= 3
      AND rn <= 2
)
SELECT 
    fl.repayment_account_id,
    fl.loan_id,
    fl.disbursed_on,
    fl.disbursed_amount,
    fl.total_loan_count
FROM filtered_loans fl
ORDER BY fl.repayment_account_id ASC, fl.disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance), 2) AS total_difference
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
    AND (abs.ledger_balance![](!) abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_difference DESC;

    pc.card_id,
    ctc.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    pc.issued_on

    payment_card pc

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS entrusted_total,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END),! 2) AS self_total,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) < 0.52
ORDER BY 
    entrusted_ratio ASC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status != 'TERMINATED' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS actual_raise_total,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS planned_raise_total,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status != 'TERMINATED' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 
        6
    ) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS overdue_loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status != 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
ORDER BY 
    overdue_loan_count DESC,
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p_borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p_payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p_borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = p_borrower.party_id
JOIN 
    party p_payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p_payee.party_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC,
    pi.instruction_id ASC;

   !ld.loan_id ASC;

    ca.contract_amount,
    p.display_name
